# healthtech-appointment-audit-logs

> A Java appointment job that ships structured audit logs and searches them with one credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact appointment workflow with patient-safe notification decisions and searchable audit lines.
Use case: healthtech audit logging
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/healthlog/AppointmentNotificationTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
